overview: The system is built around one non-negotiable rule: the LLM interprets, the system computes. A bank statement never even reaches the server whole — lib/parsers fingerprints its headers in the browser, Haiku infers a reusable format template from a 5-row sample, and the client-parsed transactions flow into lib/upload's pipeline, where a five-tier rules engine (with a Haiku fallback that writes learned merchant rules) assigns every row both a traditional category and a Foundation/Burden/Investment/Leak value category. lib/analytics then does all the arithmetic deterministically — monthly snapshots, CV-gated recurring-bill detection, Layer-3 behavioural features per merchant cluster, and the stated-intent-vs-reality gap engine — and lib/ai's context-builder assembles those pre-computed numbers into an ~18-section system prompt (11 parallel Supabase queries) for the streaming chat route. Sonnet speaks through 43 tool closures rather than doing maths, and everything it says is audited after streaming: citation tracing, a hallucinated-"saved it" recovery loop, and a persona sanitiser that rewrites off-voice messages before they can poison the prompt cache. Completed conversations are then mined back into the database (portrait traits, chat signals, correction-driven value predictions), so every chat makes the next system prompt smarter — a closed loop from CSV to context to conversation and back.

flows.name: Statement import: file to doubly-categorised ledger
steps: Browser parses CSV/XLSX locally; lib/parsers hashes sorted headers and sends only a 5-row sample
/api/detect-format has Haiku infer a cached FormatTemplate; universal-csv applies it client-side and enforces the sign convention
lib/upload/pipeline.ts dedupes via sha256 hash and runs the five-tier rules engine, then batched Haiku fallback that persists user_merchant_rules
lib/value-map rules + lib/prediction's 9-tier resolver assign Foundation/Burden/Investment/Leak
lib/analytics fans out: monthly snapshots, recurring/holiday detection, merchant aggregates, nudge evaluation
app/(office) dashboards and the chat context render the system-computed numbers

flows.name: A chat turn: prompt assembly to audited reply
steps: components/chat ChatProvider sends the message (or a hidden [System:] opener) to /api/chat
lib/ai/context-builder runs 11 parallel Supabase queries and joins ~18 prompt sections with a Bedrock cachePoint
Sonnet streams via the Vercel AI SDK, calling any of 43 createToolbox tools for every number it needs
Post-stream guards run: insight-validator traces figures to tool results, value-save-guard re-invokes Bedrock if a save was hallucinated, persona-sanitiser rewrites voice leaks with Haiku
Next.js after() fires portrait extraction and chat-signal mining; daily crons sweep any failures
MessageList parses [OPTIONS]/[STATS]/[CTA] markers and tool parts into inline interactive widgets

flows.name: Value-first onboarding: struggle to first Read
steps: app/onboarding-v2 server actions drive the onboarding_step state machine; resume.ts routes any stamp (including legacy ones) to the right screen
Goal chat is the only LLM beat — GoalBeatWatcher polls for the hand-off, handling deferral and stalls
Upload, income/rent, and fixed-cost confirmation run inside the chat sheet via OnboardingBeatHost
lib/ai/compose-first-read generates the first Read from pre-computed Layer 2/3/5 context with zero tool calls, then read-judge scores it deterministically
First Read delivery stamps completion; the Value Map becomes an optional deepening move on real hook transactions
/api/insights/recompose-first-read appends a Layer-2-aware delta Read into the same conversation

flows.name: The learning loop: corrections to smarter context
steps: User corrections and Value Map sorts land as signals in lib/prediction and lib/value-map
learning-engine.ts derives merchant, time-context, and amount-band rules (splitting a merchant at the median price when the halves disagree)
buildUserValueProfile and cluster-behaviour compute Layers 2 and 3 for the next Read and the get_cluster_behaviour tool
Cron routes evaluate declarative NUDGE_RULES with cooldowns and monthly caps; goal recompute runs TTL-gated from the office layout
gap-analyser compares stated intent with actual behaviour, feeding The Gap page, the analyse_gap tool, and portrait entries
context-builder injects it all back into the next conversation's system prompt

headline: A codebase that treats its own AI like a brilliant hire on probation — every number it utters is computed by Postgres, every claim it streams is audited and self-healed afterwards, and every session that touches the code is written into a 2,900-line institutional memory.
